An '''armor corps''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
An armor [[Corps/Legends|corps]] was comprised of three [[armored battlegroup]]s, a [[mobile battlegroup]], an [[auxiliary battlegroup]], and [[Corps/Legends#Corps HQs|corps]] headquarters. It included 74,794 personnel, 5,128 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 1,219 [[Tank|heavy tanks]].<ref name="ISB" />

Armor corps could be augmented by the addition of another three more armored battlegroups, and another mobile battlegroup.<ref name="ISB2" />
